newsitem.title: USA: PPT Vision drops after profit warning.
newsitem.headline: PPT Vision drops after profit warning.

text.p: PPT Vision Inc stock was off 1-3/8 to 7-3/4 Monday after the company said recently it anticipates pre-tax income for the fourth quarter ended October 31 to fall below analyst expectations.

"Most analysts' (estimates) were pretty well in line with $0.15 (a share) on a pre-tax basis," chief financial officer Tom Northenscold said in a telephone interview. Pre-tax earnings a year ago were $0.14 a share, he said.

Barrington Research Associates analyst Alexander Paris Sr. said he reiterated his buy rating Monday, saying the shortfall is due to modest spending by the company to expand its sales and engineering support staff.
"I think they're going to do their 20-percent-plus top-line growth," he said. "They are going into the first quarter with a better backlog than they had in the fourth quarter."
PPT designs and integrates machine-vision-based inspection systems for industry, including makers of auto and electronic components, consumer goods, pharmaceuticals and plastics.
